name: flash-backup
description: Takes about 1-2 minutes: leave the stick in until the screen says DONE -- the screen shows how many MB are copied. Keep the PCM on until then: a copy cut short by the car switching off has to be started again. (It copies in 1 MB writes with the stick set to commit=low for the copy, about 1 MB/s; without bin/fcopy it falls back to cp, 30-40 minutes.) Copies the PCM's whole 64 MB flash (bootloader, system images and /HBpersistence) to the USB stick as pcm_flash.bin, plus the activation file and stored VIN next to it. Read-only -- it is the same read the PCM's own engineering menu does (CustomerService option 05), without needing the menu. Make one before any update or experiment, then check it on a computer with PCM-Explorer (python explorer.py pcm_flash.bin check). Never overwrites an earlier backup; a copy cut short (stick pulled or full) is deleted on the next run and reported; a second copy never runs alongside the first. The file holds your VIN and activations, so don't post it. See guides/RECOVERY.md.
author: dspl1236
